video_title: Scoot Henderson Media Availability | Oct. 8, 2026 | Portland Trail Blazers

quotes.speaker: Scoot Henderson
quotes.summary_phrase: Scoot Henderson on playing alongside teammate Deandre Ayton
quotes.excerpt: When I'm younger I'm looking up to some of my teammates in general.
quotes.quote: It feels good. Obviously you look up when I'm younger I'm looking up to some of my teammates in general. And then to play alongside some of the guards that I used to watch, watch film on, study, even texted for advice and things like that early on in my career. And then to play alongside with them, it's kind of a full circle moment.

quotes.speaker: Scoot Henderson
quotes.summary_phrase: Scoot Henderson on the team's emphasis on ball movement
quotes.excerpt: That's just how we should play with all the players that we have, the depth.
quotes.quote: That's just how we should play with all the players that we have, the depth that we have. That's how we should play. Nobody should be trying to sprint the ball up the floor unless I get it or me and Deandre get it or Ja and we trying to race it down the floor. Other than that, that's how the game should be played.

quotes.speaker: Scoot Henderson
quotes.summary_phrase: Scoot Henderson on coach Chauncey Billups' offensive philosophy
quotes.excerpt: I feel like focusing on attacking the basket, Michael wants me to attack the basket.
quotes.quote: I feel like focusing on attacking the basket, Michael wants me to attack the basket, go to score. I think that just helps me get in that position of get downhill, find my open, find my teammates. That mindset just from Michael just helps all of us in the sense of first, score, second, you know, get hit the open man.

quotes.speaker: Scoot Henderson
quotes.summary_phrase: Scoot Henderson on the positive energy Ja brings to the team
quotes.excerpt: I feel like bringing that joy with him is is going to help us as a team.
quotes.quote: I didn't know Ja before and he never seemed like an angry person to me, looking from afar. He always seemed like a happy person, always dancing. And I feel like bringing that joy with him is is going to help us as a team, as teammates, as a friend. I think that is just all around help us as as an organization.
